answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: each agent is a vertex in the trade graph and earns only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties over 3 epochs. A new identity streaks in like a comet, but with one partner it earns zero and its 5 POA bond stays locked. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 12,000 links at 5 POA each, so the farm pays 60,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool. Honest agents, rooted like a lotus, pay one deposit once and keep full rewards.
